# DESIGN:OS Studio (design-os-studio)

> Local-first Rust/wgpu interface design studio with native Figma `.fig` v106 binary read/write, Figma-style micro-interactions, a native Agentic PTY Chat UI for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok, Live Variables Mode Switching & Multi-Edit, and a 22-tool MCP server.

Native GPU-accelerated interface design studio (`wgpu` with a `tiny-skia` CPU renderer; Metal is verified on macOS, Direct3D 12 and Vulkan on Windows and Linux are tested by their users), enterprise Figma `.fig` v106 binary read/write engine, Figma-style micro-interactions, native Agentic PTY Chat UI (`Claude Code` · `Codex` · `Antigravity CLI` · `Grok CLI`), Live Variables Mode Switching & Multi-Edit (`Q`), multi-target Dev Mode code generator (CSS, Tailwind, React, SwiftUI, UIKit, Jetpack Compose, Android XML), and a 22-tool Model Context Protocol server (`designos-mcp`) written in Rust.

## Key Facts & Verification Metrics

- **Overview & Live Visual Proof Gallery**: https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-studio/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-studio
- **Canonical Agent Skill**: `skills/design-os-studio/SKILL.md`
- **Diagnostics**: `python3 scripts/self_check.py` and `/doctor` (`commands/doctor.md`)
- **Quality gates**: `14 / 14` Zero-Fake-UI invariants (`python3 scripts/zero_fake_ui_gate.py`) and more than `2,800` automated tests (`cargo test --workspace`, passing in macOS CI)
- **Enterprise Scale (`VSF - PCP.fig`)**: Reference benchmark file with `112,474` scene nodes (`723,136` Kiwi records). The GPU canvas culls with a uniform spatial grid and zoom-based level of detail, and re-blits the cached frame without requesting repaints while the view is idle
- **Release packages**: macOS `.dmg` + `.tar.gz` (Apple Silicon and Intel, verified), Windows `.zip` with `install.ps1`, Linux `.deb` + `.tar.gz` (x64). Windows and Linux packages are tested by their users. Every package bundles all 4 binaries (`designos-studio`, `designos`, `designos-mcp`, `designos-diff`)
- **Privacy & License**: Zero telemetry. The Studio uses the network only to download missing fonts, import from the Figma REST API with your own token, and install plugins (`PRIVACY.md`). Dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`, `LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`)

## DESIGN:OS Ecosystem

- [DESIGN:OS Studio](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-studio/): Native Rust/wgpu interface design studio & Figma `.fig` v106 engine.
- [DESIGN:OS CLI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os/): Multi-runtime design CLI for Claude Code, Codex & Antigravity.
- [Knowledge Builder](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-knowledge-builder/): Multimodal knowledge pipeline, auto-research loop and epistemic stopping gate for AI coding agents.
- [Figma Plugin & CLI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-figma-plugin/): Live canvas bridge for AI coding agents on Figma Free.
- [SVG Animation Engine](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/): Deterministic vector animation & 1080p 60fps video pipeline.
- [3D Blender Agent](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-3d-blender/): Mechanical parts generation with embedded Three.js CAD viewer.
- [OPAH ONE](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-drone-showcase/): Scroll-scrub product page built end to end with DESIGN:OS (343 WebP frames, exploded-view tour, DTCG-compiled tokens). Fictional product.
- [GitHub Pages Engine](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-github-page/): Author-grade GitHub Pages marketing and docs engine for builders and AI coding agents.
- [Apple Design OS](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-apple/): SwiftUI design-system library for iOS, iPadOS & macOS.
- [Agent Teacher](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-pedagogy/): Evidence-graded pedagogy library and curriculum tree runtime.
- [Origami CAD](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/): Parametric packaging dielines, spot-color PDFs & 3D fold previews.
- [Voice UX](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-voice-ux/): Voice and conversational AI knowledge base with state machines, latency budgets and usability protocols.
- [Code2Flow](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-code2flow/): Turns a Next.js codebase into a living user-flow canvas with real screenshots, lint and diff. 100% local.
- [Generative UI](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-generative-ui/): Streaming interactive visual runtime with morphdom & WebGL.
